sources.title: Google Maps: THPT chuyen Le Quy Don, Da Nang
sources.finding: A narrow roof connection between the sports complex and the central rounded junction was omitted from v3. The visible pale rectangle east of the curved wing remains unclassified.
sources.limit: Satellite appearance establishes neither room function nor building height. Approximate trace uncertainty is 2–3 m; imagery date was not established.

sources.title: School notice 328, 26 August 2026
sources.finding: Canteen leased floor area is 150 square metres.
sources.limit: The six-page attachment contains no canteen location, dimensioned footprint or site plan. Leased area is not roof area.

sources.title: See Tinh mailbox at lobby C, 18 February 2023
sources.finding: Explicit lobby C identification, with a tall cream wall and timber/glass display furniture.
sources.limit: The wall-facing photographs do not locate the lobby on the satellite footprint.

sources.title: Alumni reception album, October 2026
sources.finding: The post identifies the reception as lobby A. Photographs show cream columns, a stair, display glazing and the school scale model.
sources.limit: This is evidence about A, not proof of C.

sources.title: School 40-year yearbook, public file linked by alumni page
sources.finding: 141 PDF pages containing paired printed pages. Selected contents, history, facilities, physical-education and reminiscence sections were visually reviewed (33 PDF pages). PDF page 16 / printed pages 29–30 show a recent front facade with tall glazing, pale piers and a central passage. Printed pages 177–178 mention A, B and the canteen separately.
sources.limit: No exact canteen or C location was established in the reviewed pages. Almost all pages are raster scans; a failed text search does not mean a term is absent. This was not a full visual review of the book.

sources.title: January 2024 cleaning plan, third-party copy
sources.finding: Visible text names lobbies B/C and the area in front of the canteen. An attached diagram is announced.
sources.limit: The actual diagram was not accessible in the public viewer. Grouped cleaning assignments do not establish spatial adjacency.

sources.title: Student exploration video, 2023
sources.finding: The 23:01–26:04 exploration chapter shows stairs and a curved glazed gallery.
sources.limit: No visible C label or continuous route sufficient to geolocate lobby C was established. Other student videos were sampled, not watched exhaustively.
